contract.review_scope: Body-level static contract; transitive application and called-module completeness are separate.
contract.purpose: Replace order-line condition and open quantity from selected wave shipment history slots.
inputs_defaults: condition nvarchar(25), userStamp nvarchar(30), processStamp nvarchar(100), statusReleased numeric(3), statusShipped numeric(3), launchNum numeric(9); required, no defaults.
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: Missing/NULL wave or released bound yields no qualifying aggregate row and no update. A NULL shipped bound makes all slot predicates unknown, so their CASE contributions are zero for otherwise qualifying rows.
An included NULL quantity makes that row addition NULL; SUM ignores it, and an all-NULL group may produce NULL. This body does not normalize included slot quantities.
Other waves for the same order line are not added here. Bounds are neither ordered nor validated.
output_shape: No intentional result set. No affected-row count is promised as an application result.

ordered_branches.explanation: Restrict shipment details to supplied wave and STATUS1>=statusReleased. For each selected row add quantities from ten slots whose status is >=released and <shipped.
Group by internal order number and ERP order line. Update matching ORDER_DETAIL condition, OPEN_QTY to that grouped sum and stamps.

contract.status_and_quantity_effects: Replaces OPEN_QTY; does not increment it or calculate a cross-wave total. Direct condition assignment is not an order-header rollup.
configuration_scope_and_precedence: No configuration lookup in this body; identifiers and status values are supplied by the caller.
error_and_return_handling: No TRY/CATCH or comprehensive error handling. Constraint, conversion and statement errors follow caller/session SQL Server behavior.
contract.transaction_ownership: No explicit transaction, commit, rollback, savepoint, TRY/CATCH or XACT_ABORT is introduced by this body; caller/session semantics remain authoritative.
concurrency: No body-owned snapshot or lock-based read/modify/write protocol; caller/session isolation governs concurrent observations.
contract.trigger_behavior: No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE trigger on these target tables is present in the captured six-trigger inventory, except SHIPPING_CONTAINER has an INSERT-only trigger and WORK_INSTRUCTION has an INSERT-only trigger; updates/deletes here do not directly activate those INSERT events. Constraints and caller actions still apply.
